title: Longest Common Subsequence
summary: Return the greatest length of a string that can be obtained from both inputs by deleting characters without reordering those that remain.

contractDetails.constraints: Both strings contain 1–1000 lowercase English letters.

statement: Return the greatest length of a string that can be obtained from both inputs by deleting characters without reordering those that remain.

examples.explanation: Delete x and z from the first input.
The letters are in opposite orders.

constraints: Both strings contain 1–1000 lowercase English letters.
hints: Conceptual: The chosen letters can have gaps.
Directional: Consider prefixes of both strings.
Implementation: On a match extend the diagonal state. Otherwise use the larger result from dropping one of the two final letters.
complexityAnalysis: O(mn) time and O(n) space using one rolling row.
